offering_description.value: The company provides audience targeting and campaign execution to life sciences companies and their marketing agencies. It uses health and media data to reach patients and healthcare providers through clinical workflows and other media channels, then measures and refines campaign performance.

quotes.quote: OptimizeRx is a pharma marketing company helping life sciences brands connect patients and HCPs through data-driven targeting and omnichannel activation.

Great marketing strategies deserve superior execution partners. OptimizeRx helps agencies deliver performance-driven pharma marketing with the intelligence, reach, and technology to turn ambitious plans into high-performing campaigns. • Plan with greater intelligence. Build brand-specific HCP and consumer audiences and understand where and how to reach them. ‍ • Activate with greater precision. Reach audiences around key patient journey moments across point of care and omnichannel media. ‍ • Optimize and prove performance. Continuously improve targeting and give clients transparent, independently validated results.

primary_products.value: Self-service audience planning software; predictive campaign activation software

quotes.quote: Tap into OptimizeRx intelligence in the way that works best for your team. Work directly with us to draw on 20+ years of proprietary EHR data, plus robust consumer health and media intelligence. You can also access those insights on demand through our Natural Language Audience Builder (NLAB) to create brand-specific, coordinated HCP and consumer audiences in minutes, complete with media channel propensity insights.

Reach your priority HCPs and consumers where and when they are most likely to engage and take action. OptimizeRx’s predictive targeting, powered by our Dynamic Audience Activation Platform (DAAP) makes it easy to align media flighting around key milestones in the patient journey, so brand messaging engages audiences where and when it has the most utility and impact.
